rules.name: AI color palette
rules.goal: A palette chosen for the brand, not the purple-and-cyan default.
rules.fix: Remove purple, violet and cyan gradients. Pick one brand accent, a neutral background and text colours, and use the accent sparingly.

rules.name: Aphoristic-cadence copy
rules.goal: A voice, not a formula.
rules.fix: Rewrite the repeated “X. No Y.” and “Not a feature. A platform.” lines as plain sentences. Keep one at most.

rules.name: Decorative blinking cursor
rules.goal: No fake typing where nothing can be typed.
rules.fix: Remove the animated blinking cursor from headings and hero text. Let the copy stand still.

rules.name: Border accent on rounded element
rules.goal: Rounded elements keep a clean, even edge.
rules.fix: Drop the thick accent border from rounded cards, or drop the radius. Use a full hairline border if the card needs an edge.

rules.name: Bounce or elastic easing
rules.goal: Motion that decelerates smoothly, like a real object.
rules.fix: Replace bounce, elastic and overshooting cubic-bezier curves with an ease-out curve such as cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).

rules.name: Decorative grid-line background
rules.goal: Grid lines only where something is being measured.
rules.fix: Remove the decorative hairline grid background. Keep grids for canvases, maps or technical drawings.

rules.name: Cream / beige palette
rules.goal: A background colour that comes from a deliberate palette.
rules.fix: Replace the reflexive cream or beige page colour with a background chosen from the brand palette, plain white or a considered dark.

rules.name: Glowing shadow accents
rules.goal: Depth from neutral shadows, not coloured halos.
rules.fix: Remove zero-offset coloured box-shadow and text-shadow glows. Use a soft neutral shadow with a vertical offset for elevation.

rules.name: Em-dash overuse
rules.goal: Copy with a natural rhythm.
rules.fix: Replace most long dashes in body copy with full stops, commas, colons or parentheses.

rules.name: Crushed letter spacing
rules.goal: Display type tight but still legible.
rules.fix: Ease letter-spacing on headlines back to about -0.02em to -0.04em so letters keep their shapes.

rules.name: Flat type hierarchy
rules.goal: Headings clearly outrank body text at a glance.
rules.fix: Use a type scale with steps of at least 1.25x between body, subheadings and headings, and add one decisive jump for the main headline.

rules.name: Hairline border with wide shadow
rules.goal: Cards with one clear way of standing out.
rules.fix: On rows of cards, use either a hairline border or a soft shadow, not both on every card.

rules.name: Gradient text
rules.goal: Text in one solid colour that reads instantly.
rules.fix: Fill headings and numbers with one solid colour instead of a gradient. Put emphasis in weight, size or one accent colour.

rules.name: Hero eyebrow / pill chip
rules.goal: A hero that opens with the headline itself.
rules.fix: Delete the tiny uppercase label or pill chip above the hero headline. Work any important words into the headline or the line below it.

rules.name: Icon tile stacked above heading
rules.goal: Feature lists that don't follow the stock card template.
rules.fix: Remove the rounded icon tile above each heading. Put a plain icon beside the heading, or drop the icons and lead with the text.

rules.name: Italic serif display headline
rules.goal: A headline voice that isn't the stock startup look.
rules.fix: Set the big headline and its accent words upright (roman). Keep the colour accent, or move to a non-serif display face.

rules.name: Kicker / eyebrow label above heading
rules.goal: Headings that carry their own weight.
rules.fix: Delete the small tracked label sitting above each heading. If the words matter, fold them into the heading or the first sentence.

rules.name: Marketing buzzword
rules.goal: Copy that says what the product literally does.
rules.fix: Replace words like streamline, empower, supercharge, world-class and cutting-edge with a specific verb and noun.

rules.name: Auto-scrolling marquee
rules.goal: Content that moves only when the reader moves it.
rules.fix: Replace the auto-scrolling marquee with a static row, or scroll it with the page and stop it when not visible. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: Monotonous spacing
rules.goal: Spacing with rhythm: tight inside groups, generous between sections.
rules.fix: Use a spacing scale. Shrink gaps between related items and grow the space between sections so the structure is visible.

rules.name: Nested cards
rules.goal: One level of containers; content grouped by space and type.
rules.fix: Flatten cards inside cards. Keep the outer section plain and use spacing, headings and dividers to group the items.

rules.name: Tiny numbered section labels
rules.goal: Structure that comes from content, not chapter numbers.
rules.fix: Remove the small 01, 02, 03 labels beside section headings. Let headings and spacing show the order.

rules.name: Oversized hero headline
rules.goal: A first screen with room for more than one sentence.
rules.fix: Set long headlines smaller, around 40 to 64px on desktop, or cut the headline to a few words if it must be huge.

rules.name: Overused font
rules.goal: Type that is recognisably yours, not the default of every generated site.
rules.fix: Replace Inter, Roboto, Geist, Fraunces, Plus Jakarta Sans or Space Grotesk with a less common face that suits the brand, and pair it with one body face.

rules.name: Pulsing status dot
rules.goal: Status indicators that only move when the data does.
rules.fix: Stop the decorative pulse. Show a static dot with a clear label, and animate only when the status really changes.

rules.name: Radial-gradient background halo
rules.goal: Backgrounds that are surfaces, not glowing clouds.
rules.fix: Remove the saturated radial-gradient glow behind sections. Use a solid background or a very subtle tonal shift.

rules.name: Decorative radial spotlight glow
rules.goal: Sections lit by their content, not a floating coloured haze.
rules.fix: Delete the accent-coloured radial spotlight behind the hero. If the surface needs interest, use a real image or material texture.

rules.name: Repeating-gradient stripes
rules.goal: Surfaces with deliberate texture or none.
rules.fix: Remove repeating-gradient stripes used as decoration. Use a plain surface or a real texture image.

rules.name: Shape-assembled illustration
rules.goal: Hero visuals that are real artwork, photography or product.
rules.fix: Replace the large SVG scene built from primitive shapes with a photograph, a product screenshot or a properly drawn illustration.

rules.name: Side-tab accent border
rules.goal: Cards stand apart without a thick coloured stripe down one side.
rules.fix: Remove the one-sided accent border. Separate cards with spacing, a hairline border on all sides or a subtle background change.

rules.name: Theater framing copy
rules.goal: Copy that makes a plain claim.
rules.fix: Replace “X is just theater” framing with a direct statement of what the thing does or doesn't do.

rules.name: All-caps body text
rules.goal: Long text in normal case.
rules.fix: Remove text-transform: uppercase from paragraphs. Keep capitals for short labels only.

rules.name: Body text touching viewport edge
rules.goal: Text never touches the screen edge.
rules.fix: Wrap content in a container with at least 16px (ideally 24px) side padding, or constrain the widest element so it can't overflow.

rules.name: Broken or placeholder image
rules.goal: Every image loads.
rules.fix: Give each img a real src, or remove the tag. Check the paths and that the files are deployed.

rules.name: Raster buried under a wash or opacity
rules.goal: Every image you ship is visible.
rules.fix: Lighten the wash over the background image below 90% opacity or use a blend mode, or remove the image you aren't showing.

rules.name: Positioned child clipped by overflow container
rules.goal: Menus, tooltips and popovers aren't cut off.
rules.fix: Remove overflow: hidden from the container, or move the positioned menu or tooltip outside the clipping element.

rules.name: Content invisible at rest
rules.goal: Content visible even if an animation never runs.
rules.fix: Make text visible by default and let JavaScript add the entrance animation, instead of starting at opacity 0 and waiting for a script.

rules.name: Cramped padding
rules.goal: Text inside boxes has room to breathe.
rules.fix: Add at least 12 to 16px of padding inside bordered or coloured containers.

rules.name: Color outside DESIGN.md
rules.goal: Colours match the documented palette.
rules.fix: Use a palette token from DESIGN.md, or add this colour there if it is intentional.

rules.name: Font outside DESIGN.md
rules.goal: Fonts match the documented design system.
rules.fix: Use a font from DESIGN.md, or add this one there if it is intentional.

rules.name: Font size outside DESIGN.md
rules.goal: Font sizes sit on the documented type ramp.
rules.fix: Use a size step from DESIGN.md, or add this step there if it is intentional.

rules.name: Radius outside DESIGN.md
rules.goal: Corner radii match the documented scale.
rules.fix: Use a radius token from DESIGN.md, or add this value there if it is intentional.

rules.name: Cards flush against the scroller edge
rules.goal: Cards in scrolling rows keep the same inset on both sides.
rules.fix: Size the scrolling panel to its container and add the same padding on both ends so the first and last cards aren't cut off.

rules.name: One column stretches the first viewport
rules.goal: Both columns of the opening section fit together.
rules.fix: Balance the hero columns: cap the tall one, or move its extra content below the opening row.

rules.name: Gray text on colored background
rules.goal: Text on colour stays crisp.
rules.fix: Replace grey text on coloured backgrounds with a darker shade of that colour, or white or near-white.

rules.name: Heading crowded against the previous block
rules.goal: Each heading sits closer to its own content than to the block above.
rules.fix: Increase the space above headings so it is larger than the space below them.

rules.name: Justified text
rules.goal: Even word spacing in narrow columns.
rules.fix: Use text-align: left, or add hyphens: auto if the text must stay justified.

rules.name: Layout property animation
rules.goal: Smooth animation that doesn't make the browser re-lay out the page.
rules.fix: Animate transform and opacity instead of width, height, padding or margin. For expanding panels, animate grid-template-rows.

rules.name: Line length too long
rules.goal: Lines of about 60 to 75 characters.
rules.fix: Add a max-width of about 65ch to paragraphs and text columns.

rules.name: Low contrast text
rules.goal: All text meets WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text.
rules.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background (or the reverse on dark pages) until the contrast ratio passes.

rules.name: Organic contour drawn as clip-path
rules.goal: Organic shapes that look like the real material.
rules.fix: Replace many-pointed clip-path polygons with a cut-out image or an alpha matte from the real photo. Keep clip-path for simple geometry.

rules.name: Same text repeated inside one container
rules.goal: Each card says each thing once.
rules.fix: Remove the duplicate labels repeated inside one card and keep the one where it matters most.

rules.name: Uncaught script error on load
rules.goal: The page loads without JavaScript errors.
rules.fix: Open the browser console on the page, fix the uncaught error it shows, and reload until the console is clean.

rules.name: Skipped heading level
rules.goal: Headings in order, h1 then h2 then h3.
rules.fix: Change the heading tags so no level is skipped, and style them with CSS instead of picking tags by size.

rules.name: Text occluded by an overlapping element
rules.goal: No text covered by another layer.
rules.fix: Move the overlapping box or image off the text, or give the text its own space with padding or a different stacking order.

rules.name: Content overflowing its container
rules.goal: Content stays inside its container.
rules.fix: Let text wrap, set max-width or overflow-wrap: anywhere on long strings, or give the region a visible scroll.

rules.name: Tight line height
rules.goal: Comfortable line spacing in paragraphs.
rules.fix: Set line-height to 1.5 to 1.7 for body text, and at least 1.1 for multi-line headings.

rules.name: Tiny body text
rules.goal: Body text at a readable size.
rules.fix: Set body text to at least 14px, ideally 16px.

rules.name: Undersized functional text
rules.goal: Links, buttons and labels large enough to read and tap.
rules.fix: Raise functional text such as links, buttons, nav and table cells to at least 12px.

rules.name: Wide letter spacing on body text
rules.goal: Body text with natural letter spacing.
rules.fix: Set letter-spacing on body text to 0 to 0.02em. Keep wide tracking for short uppercase labels.
